ios.desc:
Sleep deeper, focus longer and find calm in minutes. Shimmr brings together guided journeys, binaural beats and rich soundscapes, crafted by audio professionals.

JOURNEYS
• Guided sessions with a calm voice that takes you deeper, one step at a time through weight, breath and sound.
• The tones, the soundscape and the voice move together as you go deeper, then bring you gently back.
• Choose how present the voice is, from soft to clear, or turn it off.

SHIFTS
• Sessions that move you from where you are to where you want to be, like Busy to Quiet or Awake to Asleep.
• The sound changes slowly as you go, so the change feels natural.

MAKE IT YOURS
• The mixer: adjust tones, music and ambient layers while they play, then save your own mix.
• Add music to any soundscape.
• Sound Canvas: drag and drop sounds to build immersive, layered spaces.

SOUNDS FOR EVERY GOAL
• Binaural beats and isochronic tones for Delta, Theta, Alpha and Beta states.
• Solfeggio frequencies, including 432 Hz and 528 Hz.
• White, pink, brown, green and orange noise to mask distractions.
• Rain, ocean, forest and more, in high quality.

TRACK YOUR PRACTICE
• A heat map, streaks and mindful minutes show your consistency at a glance.
• Your session history shows which sounds work best for you.
• Save mindful minutes to Apple Health, and share your milestones with beautiful stats cards.

BUILT FOR LONG SESSIONS
• Every sound is built into the app, so it works offline, on flights and anywhere without signal.
• Optimized playback uses far less memory, so long sessions keep playing with the screen locked.
• iCloud keeps your mixes, favorites and progress in sync across your devices.
• No ads and no account needed.

SHIMMR PREMIUM
Premium unlocks every journey, shift and sound, plus custom mixing and full tracking.
• Monthly and yearly subscriptions, or a one-time lifetime purchase.
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID account settings.

quotes.text:
I used to work as an audio engineer and have been meditating for ~17 years. A few years back I started digging into brainwave entrainment — reading older research, patent filings, and papers (like those from the Monroe Institute), and experimenting with tone layering and sound design.

What started as a personal experiment and a way to learn iOS dev ended up becoming a full brainwave entrainment app, now live on the App Store. I released it last year after a few friends tried it and wanted their own version. It now gets several thousand users a month.

I know it's a saturated market but as I said it was only ever meant for me, but I do feel its pretty powerful app and sound wise it seems to work very well!

All the sound is generated and processed within the app — nothing is streamed. I built a flexible engine that lets each preset go through a full audio chain: compression, EQ shaping, stereo field manipulation, Haas effect, binaural panning, and reverb modulation.

So the app is incredibly flexible to attach more complex sounds in the future.

I am pretty happy with it. Please let me know what you think and if you have any cool info regarding Brain entrainment
